### Version 1.0.9
- Fixed the Sing button remaining visible after closing lyrics
- Simplified settings with automatic lyric selection

### Version 1.0.8
- Fixed lyric replacement for imported songs with plain lyrics

Thanks to [u/m9z2w4d8vw-blip](https://www.reddit.com/user/m9z2w4d8vw-blip/) for the imported-lyrics fix!

### Version 1.0.7
- More reliable lyric loading and automatic word-by-word upgrades
- Fixed Sing on local songs without an Apple Music subscription
- Improved settings and diagnostics

### Version 1.0.4
- Simpler diagnostics with one log and more Sing details
- Hold Experimental for one second to reveal diagnostics
- Added haptic feedback and removed log importing

### Version 1.0.3
- Added hidden debug and performance logging
- View, import, export and clear logs from Experimental options

### Version 1.0.2
- Fixed lyrics failing to upgrade until switching songs

### Version 1.0.1
- Fixed Music freezing or closing when opening lyrics
